steps.content: Dark clouds shrouded the entire city, and with a clap of thunder, it began to pour. A meandering stream of water scoured the wreckage, mixing blood with the liquid crystals before flowing into the low-lying sewers.
With the shackles' power, you pinpointed Hella and Ninety-Nine's location. When you arrived at the scene, you were horrified by what you saw...
The transport vehicle was overturned to one side, half shredded to pieces. The fuel that leaked out exuded a pungent smell. Hella was sprawled amidst the debris, soaked in blood.
As the knife is being pulled out of Hella's body, a pungent jet of warm blood spurted out, making you gag.
This was just like the tragic scene at Parma many years ago.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No!
Seeing that you were about to use your shackles, Nightingale immediately stopped you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It'll be suicide for your mind to use the shackles now!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Can't you see? Ninety-Nine's mutation has crossed the critical threshold! She may become a Corruptor at any time!
So? You want me to give up on her?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't come over here!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I... I can...
Hella forced herself to get up and stopped Ninety-Nine. You could tell that Hella's regeneration rate had become dangerously slow.
Ninety-Nine! Hella is here with you now!
You cannot lose your mind!
You shouted at Ninety-Nine, but it didn't seem like she could hear anything.

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: She was basically a Corruptor by now.

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: Shoot!
The FAC members who came with you raised their guns and aimed at Ninety-Nine. Gunshots rang out, and the humid air is filled with the smell of gunpowder.
However, as you expected, mere bullets could not hurt the maniacal Ninety-Nine...
No! I must try!
You pushed through the crowd to face Ninety-Nine.
Ah!!!
A state of psychological breakdown overwhelmed your mind through the shackles. Your brain felt as though it had been fried. Consequently, Ninety-Nine also turned to target you.
She lumbered towards you with a metal rod from the debris, while the ghostly Corruptor shadows behind her tried to drag you into the abyss...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ninety-Nine, stop... Ninety-Nine!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I won't let you go! I...I will save you again!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Roarrrr—!
Every time Ninety-Nine tried to run towards you, Hella crawled up to hug her to stop her from advancing.
Even though Ninety-Nine attacked Hella with all her rage, the girl refused to let go.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Let... go...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Ah!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You ****! Go! Why are you still here?!
I must save you both!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yeah right! Your shackles are useless!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm... not in pain! Back... back at Parma, this was what I and... ahhh!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This was how we got along!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I will let her... let her... ahhh—!
Ninety-Nine slammed the metal rod on Hella, splitting open her flesh.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Idiot! Go, now!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I can do it... I can make her... control herself...
Hella's voice trembled as she held Ninety-Nine tightly. You couldn't sit back anymore. You went around the crowd and headed towards Ninety-Nine.
Ninety-Nine, you really want to kill Hella?
Have you really forgotten... all of your memories together?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Let... go...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: We... we...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ninety-Nine! No!
Hella was knocked out again. The slow regeneration rate prevented her from grabbing Ninety-Nine in time.
Yet, in the storm, you suddenly understood the meaning of Ninety-Nine's words as well as the expectations in her bloodshot eyes.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Save her...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Kill me...
The shackles quickly ensnared Ninety-Nine's mind. Before she could bring down the knife, you ran to hug her.
The spirit of chaos plagued you, and your mind filled with otherworldly shrieks.
Yet deep in the abyss, you heard Ninety-Nine's voice...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: No...
I'm sorry, it's my fault... I'm too weak.
You must still yearn for this world.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Break down...
I'm sorry. I let you down at first.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: So much pain...
I need to become stronger.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Fall...
I promised to save you all. I thought I could do it because I have the shackles.
But I underestimated the power of the void... I had been arrogant.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: There's no hope left...
No matter what, I'll rescue you... and return you to Hella.
I will make the shackles... stronger.
But you must tell me clearly.
Do you yearn for death, or the sun?

steps.speaker: Girl's Voice
steps.content: "Then... do you want to go outside with me to see the sun?"

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: No... no...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: My... my sun...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I... I want... to live!
Great! I think so too!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: But... what should I do...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: I hurt Hella, and I hurt you...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: The shackles... can't save me. I'm destined... to be a monster.
I swear I'll save you! You're not destined to become a monster or be destroyed!
But I hope you understand that the shackles are not meant to manipulate your destiny or label you as a monster.
Besides, you can resist the shackles, which means... you can also resist the monsters that control you.
Ninety-Nine stared at you blankly, but you think you hear something shattering... The hell surrounding her was crumbling away.
Come back, Ninety-Nine, your Hella, your sun... awaits you.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Ahhh... so painful... so painful!
Ninety-Nine was still connected to your mind. In your mind's eye, you saw Ninety-Nine struggling and rampaging.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: No... no, no! I refuse to go back to hell! No!
Clank!
The shackles snapped. Daylight poured in, piercing your eyes.
The screams in your mind reached their peak and then drifted away. Your ears and nose were bleeding from the backlash of the snapped shackles.
Hmm? Ninety-Nine?

Something heavy rested on your shoulder, making you tense. Before you could see what it was, you raised your hand to touch it lightly. You felt the special collar on her neck, which vibrated gently with the beat of her pulse.
You let out a sigh of relief. The trapped beast broke through the cage, gave up resisting in your embrace, and now leaned softly on your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Did the manic patient calm down?

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: How was it possible...?!
The rain has stopped, Ninety-Nine.
When you wake up, we'll go see the sun together.

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: Impossible! I witnessed Sinner Ninety-Nine go manic with my own eyes! She attacked indiscriminately!
But you also witnessed how my shackles brought her...
...and her Syndrome Mania under control.
In the Office
In the surveillance camera, Ninety-Nine was still confined in her cell, but her eyes, hands, and feet were no longer bound like they were last time.
It has been ten days since the transport vehicle incident. Ever since Ninety-Nine woke up, she hasn't shown any manic symptoms, and her infection levels have largely halted.
Her stats, which include brain wave magnetic nuclear analyses and detailed reports of bodily fluid temperature, are recorded daily.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: All the reports and records are here for the FAC inspectors to use.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: If you have any other questions, you can go directly to the Bureau for a site visit.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We set up an observation room across from Sinner Ninety-Nine's cell...

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: Enough. Let this be the end of it. We will allow this Sinner to stay at the MBCC.

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: But this does not mean we completely trust this Sinner. We will conduct random checks unannounced.

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: If she shows any abnormalities during this period, we will execute her immediately.

steps.speaker: FAC researcher
steps.content: Along with that monkey-like Sinner by her side.
Don't worry. With Hella and I here, that would never happen again.
The meeting ended. You and Nightingale watched as the FAC investigators left, then headed to the cell where Ninety-Nine and Hella were being held.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, can you really guarantee that Ninety-Nine won't go manic again?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Though you managed to bring her under control, we still haven't figured out why the mental infection dropped rapidly after she crossed the critical threshold.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's as if it disappeared into thin air...
I cannot guarantee... but I'm not scared, either.
After all, this incident proved that my power got stronger.
At least I can control mental infections as severe as Ninety-Nine's.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I hope this is the case.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh right, Chief...
Nightingale opened a report in exasperation.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, 85% of the staff believe that Ninety-Nine and Hella should not be confined together.
Why?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's too dangerous for them to be together. They might escape again at any time.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Ninety-Nine doesn't understand anything and obeys whatever Hella says.
They almost died. Can't we make it up to them by letting them stay together?
Moreover... I believe that Hella is beneficial to controlling Ninety-Nine's mania.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! Ninety-Nine... pay attention to me, Ninety-Nine...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Okay, I will pay attention to you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhh— not like this!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Then tell me! What do you want to play?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Oh, what do you want to play?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: If possible, anything but the game where I throw you into the air and then catch you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why?!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Chief said it would be hard to fix the ceiling if we dent it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: My God! My Ninety-Nine rejected me because of the Chief!
Hmm? Anything wrong with that?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Chief? Why are you here?
If I hadn't come, the ceiling would've suffered.
It seems like that aside from stopping you from escaping, I also have to stop you from demolishing the place...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yeah right! I won't do anything Ninety-Nine doesn't want!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm happy just to be by Ninety-Nine's side!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But today Ninety-Nine rejected me... I'm so sad! I will give her the silent treatment for five minutes!
Hella ran to a corner of the room and squatted down stubbornly, leaving her back to you and Ninety-Nine.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Should I go and soften things up?
No need. I think she did it so I can speak to you alone.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Speak to me alone...

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella once told me that important things must be said face-to-face.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: After thinking about it, I have some very important things to tell you.
A smile of relief shone on Ninety-Nine's face.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Hella helped me escape from Parma... and you wrenched me back from the abyss.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Thank you for controlling the beast inside me.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Now... I can attain true freedom.
